whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. Satyam Kumar,

I noticed Meera Dental Clinic has an incredible 5.0★ rating with 1,000+ reviews in Sipara, Patna, but your current website could be elevated into a high-converting digital booking portal.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom high-end website concept design kiya hai — jisme instant WhatsApp appointment booking, painless RCT showcase, aur interactive patient reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.meeradentalclinic.online/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dr. Satyam Kumar, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic, Meera Dental Clinic, ke liye ek custom high-end website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with your 5.0-star Google reputation, 1,000+ patient reviews, and direct WhatsApp appointment booking for Patna patients. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact treatments, actual clinic photos aur booking setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
